analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (179,100 KRW) vs SMA5 (177,600 KRW)/SMA20 (195,765 KRW)/SMA50 (225,063 KRW): short-term trend above, mid-term trend below
· Position vs SMA100 (239,687 KRW)/SMA200 (238,561 KRW): long-term trend below, weak territory
· 52-week position (28.8%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.8→39.1): entering oversold territory, attempting upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-536.7635→-949.0138): continued worsening, bearish convergence
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 165,037 KRW): approaching lower band, 31.39% band width suggests potential volatility expansion
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (167,300 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (154,733 KRW) and Bollinger lower band (165,037 KRW)
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW): below Pivot R1 (217,733 KRW), trend reversal expected on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low formed, sideways): trend reversal uncertain
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.89x): subdued confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): consider buying after confirmation of 167,300 KRW support, bullish reversal upon breaking 209,000 KRW resistance
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일한 169,000원으로, 뚜렷한 Higher Low 패턴 미형성. 현재가 179,100원은 52주 저가(99,900원) 대비 높은 수준이나, 52주 고가(374,500원) 대비 현저히 낮은 위치.
